15. (Currently amended) A method for selecting a first server computer for sending data to a client computer, comprising:
accessing a second server computer through a path in a computer network, the path including one or more server computers;
adding information indicative of at least one server computer of a first set of one or more server computers to a locator of a resource on the second server computer, __the information being added to the locator as a unique signature__;
sending the locator from the second server computer to the client computer;
selecting the locator by the client computer; and
subsequently generating __by a web browser of the client computer__ an http request out of this locator, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request, and selecting the first server computer based on the information added to the locator.

16. (Currently amended) The method of claim 15, the second server computer being a Web application server comprising a Web page with a hyperlink referencing the data to be sent to the client computer, the hyperlink including [[a]] __said__ unique signature, the method further comprising the steps of selecting the hyperlink by the client computer, and subsequently generating an http request out of this hyperlink by a web browser, this http request containing the unique signature identifying a media request.

17. (Currently amended) The method of claim 15, further comprising providing the information to a media request broker in response to [[a]] __the__ selection of __the locator by__ the client computer, the media request broker selecting the first server computer based on the information.

18. (Currently amended) The method of claim 17, the media request broker selecting the first server computer based on the information __contained in the unique signature of the http request__.
